svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: 27 keys F3 .. G5: play the cursor's channel; in edit mode (REC) they enter notes. With GLO held the white keys mute channels 1 .. 16.
Every page shows its controls in its footer. HOME, SEQ, ENV, GLO pressed again switch the page's view.
